text_block_list.text:
I was at the track one afternoon,
there to observe,
while the students were training hard.

One runner ran with a strong,
sturdy style that caught my eye.
It was Fenomeno,
the girl I met the other day.

With her powerful stride and stamina,
it seemed to me she had the makings of a
great stayer.
She could even put up a good fight at the
Twinkle Series, probably.

But the most striking thing about her running
was the sense of sincerity I felt.
As if her overflowing devotion to justice
was given form――

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: WHAZZUUPPP!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey hey! Ya got yer beans clean!? 
You're never gonna be an Elite Bean Agent
if you keep runnin' like that, Mamechin!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...Be― Be careful, Golshi-san!
Don't start running without warning!
What if you had hit me!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Pfft! If that's all it takes to freak you out,
then you're all toast and no beans!
Neener neener neener~~~☆

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... Not only are you running recklessly,
but you're engaging in unsportsmanlike conduct,
too!
This is a violation! A violation, I say!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
STOP          RIGHT           THERE!!
YOU'RE       UNDER         ARREST!!

...The girl with a big smile on her face
was the school's notorious problem child,
Gold Ship.
It seems her arrival completely broke
Fenomeno's concentration.

Their cat-and-mouse game looked like it
would drag on for a while...
I doubt I'd be able to see Fenomeno run with
full focus any time soon.

After that,
I started noticing Fenomeno around the
school――

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...I can smell it! The scent of crime...
Whoever you are,
you can't escape the nose of the Disciplinary
Committee!

Psst, you know that "good stuff"...?
...I got it.
text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Here you are!
――NGWHAAAA!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, we've got you now, Meno!
I knew you'd show up if we did some shady
stuff!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Darn you―― You're in violation of noise
rules!
And, indiscriminately engaging in suspicious
behavior is obstruction of school duties!
Stop this immediately!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I can smell it... I can smell it...!
Wait,
I literally smell it!?
Is it coming from here!?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
It's you all again!?
It reeks of squid... Agh,
what are you cooking in here?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Tsk, guess we're busted...
We're cookin' up some high-class dried squid.
It's real good. Wanna try some?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: I do not! Put this all away immediately!!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I do apologize for the smell.
We'll deal with it right away.
...But we're only having a little gathering
here, so could you please overlook this?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... Well, if you deal with the smell,
then I suppose... Wait, no! That aside,
taking advantages of school facilities like
this is already against the rules!

――Every day,
Fenomeno would be strung along by the
troublemakers around her,
just like that. It seems her honest,
disciplined attitude made it hard for her
to ignore them.

――One day,
we hosted a tour of Tracen for the local
primary school Umamusume,
letting them watch the students train.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
We will now begin the tour of the campus
training facilities.
All of you, make two orderly lines,
and follow us.

text_block_list.name: Primary School Umamusume
text_block_list.text: R-right...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hold up,
are you kids feeling down or what?
C'mon,
try and live it up a little!
Giant squid style!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Golshi-san,
please try refrain from your unserious
antics!
We have to give them a proper tour!!

Gold Ship and Fenomeno were helping guide
the kids along.
The kids took an immediate liking to the
former,
while getting scared of the latter...
It was a little worrying.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
This workout machine is dangerous,
so please refrain from touching it.
This piece of equipment, however,
is safe to try.

text_block_list.name: Primary School Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Yay!!

The tour was going well up to that point. 
The plan was to head to the training track
and show the kids a mock race...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
I can't believe I have the oppurtunity to
work with you... It's an honor!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Though it may not be as unbelievable as I
said.
It's no surprise someone as excellent as
you would help organize this tour.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Your consideration for the children's future
shows your noble heart and righteous values...
I'd be honored if you allowed me to follow
your example!

...For some reason,
she had a very positive image of me. 
A fairly romanticized one, though.

choice_data_list: Let's make this tour a good one.
Let's make this tour a good one.
text_block_list.text:
Well,
she was spot on about my consideration for
the kids. 
They were hoping to be racers one day,
so I wanted to help them make the most out
of this experience.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
I'm assigned to run in the mock race after
this.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I will do everything in my power to serve
as a good example for the children!
...Eek.
text_block_list.name: Timid Umamusume Child

text_block_list.text:
Fenomeno focused herself,
forming an intense look in her eyes,
which intimidated the children around her.
...Again, a little worrying.
